acceptance_criteria.description: Multi-metric gate: All metrics must pass across N consecutive windows. Conservative defaults to prevent overfitting.

experience_buffer.description: Fixed capacities: 10k transitions each (top/bottom 25% episodes). Sampling: 75% PPO, 15% BC, 10% negative correction.

normalization.description: Rewards clipped to [-1, 1]. Running mean/std normalization for rewards and observations to stabilize learning.

position_sizing_layer.description: Currently using discrete actions. Continuous position sizing can be enabled for better risk control.

paper_testing.description: Training continues during paper testing to allow rollback. Auto-rollback triggers if metrics degrade. paper_test_episodes controls paper validation length.

training_loop.description: Delay multi-metric evaluation until sufficient experience is collected to reduce early overfitting/false positives.

auto_tighten.description: If repeated eval failures or rollbacks occur, automatically tighten gates (higher WR/PF/Sharpe, lower DD) and resume training.
